description: This PHP source file manages a web interface for configuring voice SIP advanced service provider settings, including enable/disable options, DSCP/QoS settings, and SIP client control actions.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Function that retrieves current SIP and voice profile settings from the device via getStr calls.

methods.name: page_load_values
methods.description: Loads current configuration values into the form fields based on data fetched from the device.

methods.name: get_set_val
methods.description: Collects the current form input values into a JavaScript object for submission.

methods.name: sipclient
methods.description: Starts or stops the SIP client based on user interaction, sending the request to the server via AJAX.
